text: This report provides an update on TO Live's cybersecurity controls and risks.

The TO Live - Finance and Audit Committee recommends that the Board of Directors of TO Live: 1. Approve new and updated cybersecurity policies 501 through to 510, as attached in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (August 25, 2023) from the President and Chief Executive Officer, TO Live. 2. Direct that Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (August 25, 2023) from the President and Chief Executive Officer, TO Live remain confidential in its entirety, as it involves security of the property of the Board.
